title: Model Context Protocol Python SDK: Client fetched server-chosen $ref URLs while validating tool results against output…
description: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) Python SDK versions 1.10.0 through 1.29.1 and 2.0.0 through 2.1.1 contain a vulnerability where the client fetches server-chosen $ref URLs during tool result validation. This allows a malicious server to cause the client to make network or local file requests synchronously without timeout, potentially freezing the client session. The issue is fixed in versions 1.30.0 and 2.2.0.
